text.p: Ecuador's Government Minister Frank Vargas Pazzos resigned Monday, allegedly because he disagreed with the makeup of the Supreme Court.
"Since the beginning, I said I would be in government a short time," he told local radio. "I tried to set up certain policies and I consider that I have done that and therefore I am going."

However, radio station Noti Hoy reported that Vargas, who presented his resignation Monday night to President Abdala Bucaram, openly disagreed with the makeup of the Supreme Court, which was recently reshuffled by Congress with the majority of the new judges being members of the ruling party and the opposition Social Christian Party.
Vargas, a retired general, was a presidential candidate in this year's elections, but he was the first politician to support Bucaram in the second round of vote.
It was not immediately announced who will replace Vargas.
